title: Yi-Ping T NDEs
content:
The first near death experience happened to me when I was age 21. I went to the hot springs and then my heart suddenly stopped. I had no heart-beat for 5 minutes. I woke up with help from people surrounding me. I saw the shadows of my grandparents and a little girl, whom I couldn't recognize who she was. I was in a completely dark place.

The second near death experience happened when I was age 28. I was meeting with my colleagues at McDonald's. I drank 5 cups of coffee, not thinking about my health. This caused me to have a heart attack. My heart was born abnormal. I passed out. Then I saw a bright light and heard beautiful music from heaven. Everything was shining like gold, even though I didn't know what it was. After I woke up, I was in the hospital already.

The third near death experience happened when I was age 32. I was walking with a foal in the horse ranch. The fool's legs accidentally kicked my chest. I couldn't breathe and my heart suddenly stopped. What I remembered was that I fell on the ground. Only a few seconds later, I saw myself in the sky and I flew as a balloon. At the same time, I was very confused about seeing my body lying on the grass. My colleagues tried to help me. I was happy and fearless because I saw the blue sky and clouds. I even could feel the breeze. I saw everything so clearly. I didn't even care if I was dead or alive. Around 5 seconds later, I started fall like an airplane crashing to the ground. I felt like I was buried in the deep ground. I tried to push away the soil and got out from the underground.

After I woke up, my colleagues told me that they thought I was dead because my heart stopped for more than 10 minutes. After the doctor checked on me, he told me that it was a miracle because my heart attack didn't affect my pregnancy - my baby was still alive. I am 52 now and my son just barely turned to 19. My daughter is almost 18 years old.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Happy and fearless; very confused; 'I flew as a balloon'; felt the breeze.

arrival.other_being_detail: Shadows of grandparents and 'a little girl' she could not recognize.

environment.environment_other_detail: Completely dark place (first NDE); bright light and 'everything was shining like gold' with 'beautiful music from heaven' (second NDE); blue sky, clouds, breeze (third NDE).

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Third NDE: after ~5 seconds, 'I started fall like an airplane crashing to the ground' and then experienced being 'buried in the deep ground' and pushing out; other NDEs: 'I woke up' / 'After I woke up, I was in the hospital already.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Three events described: (1) hot springs then heart suddenly stopped (no heartbeat 5 minutes); (2) heart attack after drinking 5 cups of coffee (congenital abnormal heart); (3) chest kicked by a foal at horse ranch causing inability to breathe and heart stopped (colleagues thought >10 minutes).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard 'beautiful music from heaven'; saw shadows of grandparents and an unknown little girl; experience of being buried underground and pushing out.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Across three NDEs: darkness with shadow figures (first), bright light/music/golden shining (second), OBE above body with sky/breeze then falling/buried underground (third).
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Third NDE: 'At the same time, I was very confused about seeing my body lying on the grass' while being in the sky.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Third NDE included 'I flew as a balloon' and later 'I felt like I was buried in the deep ground' and pushed away soil to get out.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was in a completely dark place.” “Then I saw a bright light and heard beautiful music from heaven.” “Everything was shining like gold.” “I saw myself in the sky and I flew as a balloon.” “Around 5 seconds later, I started fall like an airplane crashing to the ground.” “I felt like I was buried in the deep ground. I tried to push away the soil and got out from the underground.”
